title: Lovely Crisp Irish Lamb Skewers
description: Savory Irish lamb skewers featuring panang curry paste, caramelized to perfection, and suitable for a low-glycemic diet. This dish showcases the rich flavors of Ireland with a twist of Asian spice.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together panang curry paste, coconut oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the curry paste mixture.
Thread the lamb cubes, onion, bell pepper, and zucchini onto metal skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes.
Increase the oven temperature to broil and cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until the lamb is caramelized and crispy.
Remove the skewers from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
